clips.title: The story
paras: Outside the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City, Archmage Malin directs arcane affairs. A former pupil of Archmage Trelane, he coordinates field agents seeking magical artifacts and rare reagents across the Eastern Kingdoms.

Archmage Malin is the central contact for Stormwind's arcane practitioners, stationed beneath the Wizard's Sanctum in the Mage Quarter. He learned magic under Archmage Trelane, and now works to protect the scattered legacy of his former master. While acolytes study inside the tower, Malin watches over matters across the realm that need magical oversight.

Archmage Malin directs much of his attention north, to the perilous ruins of the Arathi Highlands. He sent his trusted associates, Skuerto and Apprentice Kryten, to recover Archmage Trelane's lost possessions and secure delicate spell components. From the capital, Malin coordinates their work and relies on capable Alliance travelers to carry instructions, supplies, and intelligence to his agents in hostile territory.
